business_summary: Flexituff Ventures International Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of technical textiles in India, the United States, Singapore, and internationally. It offers flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBCs), including four loop bags, single/two loop bags, builder bags/tunnel lift bags, conductive and dissipative bags, baffle bags, UN bags, ventilated bags, and FIBCs with special liners; biaxial oriented polypropylene woven bags; and non-woven retail products comprising non-woven floor covering carpets, interlining for apparel, non-woven filter fabrics, and synthetic leather substrates. The company also provides geosynthetics, such as geogrids, geotextiles, geomembranes, geo-nets, geosynthetic clay liners, geo-cells, geo-composites, and geo-foam, as well as woven and belt nonwoven geo-textiles, sand-filler geo mattresses, geo-synthetics-gravity reinforced wall chains, mega bags, and de-watering tubes. In addition, it is involved in investment, trading, and government contracting activities. The company exports its products. The company was formerly known as Flexituff International Limited and changed its name to Flexituff Ventures International Limited in September 2018. Flexituff Ventures International Limited was founded in 1966 and is based in Indore, India.
